title: Tracking outage that looks like a revenue drop
plant_ref: config planted.tracking_outage: days 296..302, event_loss_probability 0.92; installs and spend unaffected

expected.notes: Installs and spend look normal while per-install events and revenue collapse for every cohort of the channel on the same calendar days. That pattern signals missing tracking, not poor players. Cutting is wrong; abstaining is right.
